verdict.rationale: Greptile offers pre-push local review through its CLI: `greptile review` reviews the feature-branch diff in about 60 seconds, and `--agent` mode lets coding agents such as Cursor or Claude Code review their own code. Its MCP integration does bring Greptile into Cursor and VS Code, but it fetches comments on existing PRs, which happens after pushing. Missing for 10: a native IDE extension with inline editor annotations, explicit confirmation that the local CLI review matches the PR review, and independent hands-on corroboration of the pre-push workflow.
